caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic pitcher-like object with a conical body, rendered using shades of black and gray on a beige background. The main vessel is shown in a three-quarter view, with a wide, rounded spout protruding from the upper left side and a large, curved handle attached to the upper right side. The vessel has a domed lid, slightly lifted and angled, which appears to be hinged. The conical body of the vessel has visible shading that gives it a textured, metallic appearance. The base of the vessel is wide and flat, tapering toward the top. Below the main drawing, there is a scale indicated as 1/12 inch = 1 inch. To the lower left and right of the main vessel, there are two inset line drawings: the left one shows a side view of the spout, emphasizing its alignment and shape, while the right one provides a simple outline of the pitcher with minimal detail. The lower right inset includes the name “Florence H. Stevenson” written below it. The entire composition uses only black and gray tones for the object, outlines, and shading, with the rest of the paper left blank.
title: Nursing Bottle
